BiblicalUsage: Moicheia is adultery itself, named among the evils that come out of the heart — out of the heart proceed evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, fornications, thefts. Jesus puts it in the list of what defiles a man, not what goes into him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the list is the diagnosis: the heart is where adultery starts, long before the bed.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
